_doc: Per device config for scripts/vm_smoke.sh. Keys are repo paths. kind: audio | instrument | rack. ready: {global, regex} polls Global(<name>).text for the regex (DSP-ready trace), else the track meter must move. skipParams: names or /regex/ to skip. readyTimeoutMs, budgetS optional. readyInstances: distinct trace ids required (default 2 = both instances; a rack of 2 chains on 2 tracks = 4).

devices/Tiny Space.amxd.notes: gen core created at load; meter > 0 is the ready probe

devices/Better Sampler.amxd.notes: deferred gen; plays the MIDI clip, no sample loaded so output may be silent (WARN only: needsSignal false)

devices/Transient Split.adg.notes: rack of two chains; params of both chains are swept; linking inside one rack is expected

devices/Transient Split.amxd.notes: standalone (no rack): control for the .adg run
